meta.title: feat(prisma): add middleware to detect and report slow Prisma queries to Sentry
meta.body_summary: Add a Prisma middleware to detect slow queries (>SLOW_QUERY_THRESHOLD_MS) and report them to Sentry with rate limiting, targeting better database performance observability.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added slow-query middleware; reviewer zomars CHANGES_REQUESTED due to mutable globals, lack of true integration tests, and design issues; PR closed after 12 days inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 7839 changed lines, this is a large change by absolute volume, though most churn comes from a merge commit. As a moderate observability performance PR, it was closed without merge because the reviewer identified fundamental design and testing flaws that were not resolved.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer flagged mutable globals incompatible with Vercel Fluid, misuse of INSIGHTS_DATABASE_URL, unnecessary import changes, duplicate middleware application, and required true integration tests against a real database instead of mocks.
review_details.performance_claim: Detect and report slow Prisma queries to Sentry to aid performance debugging, with configurable threshold and rate limiting.
review_details.rejection_signals: CHANGES_REQUESTED with multiple unresolved concerns; closed stale after 7 days inactivity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin attempted to add observability middleware but struggled with environment-specific constraints (Vercel Fluid) and proper test strategy (real vs mocked Prisma). Despite many iterations, it could not satisfy reviewer requirements.

detection_detail.code_reading: zomars provided detailed inline feedback on mutable globals, test approach, unnecessary imports, and middleware duplication.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body claims integration tests, but reviewer deemed them insufficient; no before/after performance data provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after multiple rounds of fixes that did not address core concerns; Devin bot closed it for 7+ days inactivity.

core_change_summary.description: Add slowQueryDetection middleware in packages/prisma/middleware/slowQueryDetection.ts that tracks Prisma query timings and reports slow queries (>SLOW_QUERY_THRESHOLD_MS) to Sentry with rate limiting. Wire into packages/prisma/index.ts and add tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Initial unit test file was later removed; integration test iterated multiple times; a prismaMock.ts was added then removed per review.
change_trajectory: Initial middleware implementation with unit tests and mutable rate-limit state.
Review feedback: mutable globals not compatible with Vercel Fluid; need true integration tests, not mocks.
Devin iterates: improves types, adds integration test (but still uses mocks), adds prismaMock fixture.
Further review: remove prismaMock, use real database; remove unnecessary import changes and duplicate middleware application.
Devin adjusts integration test to use real db connections, reverts import changes, removes mock file.
Chat about snapshot test for SQL; Devin adds snapshot.
PR closed stale by bot after 12 days with unresolved concerns.

review_signals.summary: We should avoid mutable globals since we have Fluid compute enabled in Vercel.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin later refactored middleware to use WeakMap for per-client state.

review_signals.summary: INSIGHTS_DATABASE_URL has nothing to do with the slow query middleware.
This is a unit test; I've asked for integration tests that test actual db operations.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin created integration-test file, but initially used mocks; later iterated to use real db.

review_signals.summary: Remove prismaMock.ts file; do not mock Prisma in integration tests.
There is no need to change this import.
readOnly prisma already uses customPrisma which has the middleware.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin removed the redundant middleware call.

review_signals.summary: Remove this change (conditional middleware on readonlyPrisma).
Add a snapshot of actual captured rawSql to ensure it's working.

review_signals.action_taken: Devin attempted to fix issues but never received approval.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with slow-query middleware and unit tests.
zomars quickly reviewed and raised multiple design and testing concerns.
Devin iterated across many commits addressing some issues but struggled with true integration tests and mutable globals.
After the last round of fixes, no approval was given, and the PR sat inactive for over a week.
Devin bot closed the PR due to 7+ days inactivity.
